Name: Ducati Motorbike Custom Mount Kit
Author: SkylarkL
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
When assembled, adds a Ducati Motorbike with engine sounds, three motorcycle helmets, a bike shed with working garage door, and reskins the horse flute to match the Ducati. The Ducati and its shed will exist alongside the vanilla horse, which it is intended to supplant (be used instead of). The assembly required is simple and easy and consists of moving files between folders; this is done out of respect for clefairykid and MissCoriel. 
Compatible with Horse Squeeze. 
Demetrius will send you a letter with a motorcycle helmet [i]immediately [/i]after you purchase the shed, and the Ducati mount should gain a speed boost from oil instead of carrots.
The motorbike is not intend to wear a hat, so don't put a hat on it unless you want it to look very silly. 

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Assembly & Installation instructions[/size][/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]If you don't understand what these instructions are asking you to do, please ask for help in the modded-tech-support channel of the Stardew Valley discord. If any words used by these instructions confuse or are unknown to you, please search them in Wiktionary (wiktionary.org). [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Instructions for assembling your Ducati Motorbike Custom Mount Kit for Content Patcher and Custom Mounts:

1. Download and install the latest version of SMAPI (smapi.io), following its instructions.

2. Download and install the latest version of Content Patcher per its instructions.

3. Download and install the latest version of Custom Mounts per its instructions.[/color]

[i][color=#D4D4D8]Note: Generic Mod Configuration Menu (GMCM) is excluded from these instructions because, w[/color][/i][color=#D4D4D8][i]hile it is listed as a requirement, it is entirely optional.[/i]

4. Create a new folder for staging your Ducati Motorbike Custom Mount Kit components in whatever location makes sense to you, and name it in a way that makes sense to you.

5. Download CK's Ducati Motorbike (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2918) and the classic version of Tractor Engine Sounds (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5781); Do Not install them or download and install any of their listed requirements, especially Custom Music and PYTK as they both are depreciated and no longer function. The Horse to Ducati Motorbike Conversion Kit does not require Custom Music because it uses both Content Patcher's audio functions, which were added in 2024, as well as those of Custom Mounts, instead.

6. Place the three zipped mod folders (Ducati Motorbike Custom Mount Kit, CK's Ducati Motorbike, and Tractor Engine Sounds) into your new staging folder, then unzip all three mods inside the staging folder. I personally recommend that you move the main mod folders from their extraction folders to the main part of the staging folder so you do not have to deal with an additional and unnecessary layer of folder nesting, and then delete the empty extraction folders.

7. Locate the following files in the four unzipped mod folders:

"BikeShed.png", "DucatiEdits.png", "Helmets.png" and "Flute.png" in the "assets" folder of "[CP] Ducati Motorbike Custom Mount Kit".
"content.json", "instructions.txt", and "manifest.json" in the main folder of "[CP] Ducati Motorbike Custom Mount Kit".
"horse.png" in the "horseassets" folder of "[CP] CK's Ducati Motorbike".
"tractor.wav" in the main folder of "[CM] Tractor Sounds".

If any of these files are missing, delete all files & folders associated with their respective mod(s) and repeat steps 5 through 7 for those mod(s).
Please note that "DucatiEdits.png" is an overlay for CK's Ducati Motorbike sprite sheet ("horse.png") that adds single-pixel highlights to the motorbike's wheels in order to illustrate their rotation, and looks completely blank when seen as an icon.

8. Move "horse.png" and "tractor.wav" from their original locations (listed in step 7) to the "assets" folder inside the "[CP] Ducati Motorbike Custom Mount Kit" folder.

9. Review the contents of the "[CP] Ducati Motorbike Custom Mount Kit" folder and double check that they are as follows: "instructions.txt", "content.json", "manifest.json", and the "assets" folder; the "assets" folder should contain "BikeShed.png", "DucatiEdits.png", "DucatiFlute.png", "Helmets.png", "horse.png" and "tractor.wav". If any are missing, re-do steps 7 through 9 for them.

10. Once your "[CP] Ducati Motorbike Custom Mount Kit" folder contents match the list in step 9, Congratulations! You have successfully assembled your custom mount kit! It is finally time to move the "[CP] Ducati Motorbike Custom Mount Kit" folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder. Once that has been done, the staging folder and its contents will no longer be needed and you may safely delete them.

11. DO NOT assemble this mod and then redistribute it in an assembled state, edited or otherwise! Doing so is a violation of the asset usage permissions set by clefairykid and MissCoriel. You may, however, make edits to their assets for your own use. I personally encourage users of this mod who do not like the up-and-down motion of the motorbike's sprite to use image editing software to merge "DucatiEdits.png" down onto "horse.png" and then move half of the Ducati sprites up or down one pixel to eliminate the bounce, making sure that the file retains its name and location (and that there is only one "horse.png"); then set the custom mount kit's only configuration option to a checked box, if using "Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)", or find the mod's "config.json" file, found in the main folder of "[CP] Ducati Motorbike Custom Mount Kit" after the game has been run with it in the "Mods" folder, and change "false" to "true" (quotation marks excluded). Again, DO NOT distribute your edited "horse.png" out of respect for clefairykid.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Other information[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I am aware that the bike shed rides high and lacks a shadow in the carpentry menu. It doesn't interfere with the mod's functionality, so it's staying as-is until I have the energy to deal with it.[/size][/color]

This mod does not have a i18n at present. This is the case because I am a beginner modder who does not have a lot of mental energy these days. I will add one and MissCoriel's "tractor.wav" (now that I have her permission to do so) to the mod once I am feeling up to it.
